note: Prices used to turn the raw usage in article-log.json into dollars. The log stores tokens and searches, not dollars, so changing a price here corrects every old job at the next view. All prices are USD per million tokens (MTok). 'cacheWrite' is the 5-minute cache write price; cache reads are what a repeated, cached prompt costs. A price with verified:false is an assumption and its cost is shown with an asterisk.
verifiedFrom: platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (Anthropic's pricing page), read 2026-10-09 and matched against Tom's screenshots of the same page
_webSearch: Anthropic's pricing page: web search is $10 per 1,000 searches, plus the normal token cost of the content it returns; a search that errors is not billed. The web fetch tool is free, and Jerome fetches pages with its own code, which costs nothing.
_tokenizer: IMPORTANT FOR COMPARING MODELS: Anthropic's page says Claude 4.7 and later models use a newer tokenizer that produces about 30% more tokens for the same text; Claude Sonnet 4.6 and earlier use the previous one. So a model with a lower price per token can cost nearly the same per job. Compare the cost of a whole run, not the price per million.

gemini-3.5-flash-lite._source: ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/latest-model (Google's own page), read 2026-10-09: $0.30 in / $2.50 out per 1M tokens. Thinking tokens are billed as output. No cache price entered: Thomas does not use Gemini's cache.

gpt-5.6-luna._source: developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.6-luna (OpenAI's own page), read 2026-10-09: $0.20 in / $0.02 cached in / $1.20 out per 1M tokens; cache writes at 1.25x the input rate. Reasoning tokens are billed as output. Prompts over 272K input tokens cost 2x input and 1.5x output (Thomas's judge prompts are tiny).

claude-haiku-5-5._longPrompt: Haiku 5.5 is priced by the length of each request's prompt: a request whose prompt (all input tokens, including cache reads and writes) is over 100,000 tokens pays the higher prices. Each request is priced on its own, so the log keeps requests over the threshold in a separate bucket.

_notEntered: Other models on the page (Opus 5 / 4.x, Sonnet 5 / 4.5, Haiku 4.5 and older, Mythos) are not entered because nothing uses them yet. Add a model here, spelled exactly as the service reports it, before using it. Batch API (50% off), data residency (1.1x for US-only inference) and fast mode multipliers are not applied because nothing uses them. A step that charges by something else (audio by characters, images by picture) reports its own dollars as usage.otherUsd.
